headline: 1,181 hospitalized in 24h as 4 more die of dengue
summary: The total death toll for the year has reached 335, with over 108,000 patients admitted to hospitals according to the DGHS.
details: Four people died from dengue fever in the last 24 hours, according to a report from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) released on Friday.
A total of 1,181 new patients were admitted to hospitals within the same 24-hour period.
This brings the total number of dengue-related deaths this year to 335.
The total number of hospitalizations for the year has now reached 108,440 patients.
Of those admitted, 102,210 patients have been discharged from hospitals so far this year.

headline: 16,620 passengers stranded as 107 flights to Saudi Arabia cancelled
summary: Thousands of travelers are left in limbo after a massive wave of flight cancellations affecting routes to Saudi Arabia.
details: A total of 107 flights destined for Saudi Arabia have been cancelled, leaving 16,620 passengers stranded.
The sudden cancellations have caused significant disruption for thousands of travelers, many of whom were preparing for travel to the Kingdom.
Passengers are currently facing uncertainty regarding their travel arrangements and rescheduling options.
The scale of the cancellations has created a major logistical challenge for airlines and airport authorities.
